PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience delivering KPI reporting, automation, and business insights across

Query), Tableau, Excel, and Python, with proven ability to gather requirements, define KPIs, build dashboards, 
validate data, and present insights to stakeholders. Focused on improving reporting accuracy, reducing manual effort, 
and enabling faster decision-making through data-driven recommendations. Experienced in operations reporting, KPI 
governance, and stakeholder communication across cross-functional teams.

PROJECTS 
 
 
Telecom Billing & Revenue Assurance System 
Worked on a billing and revenue assurance platform to ensure accurate charging, invoicing, and leakage 
detection across prepaid and postpaid services. Gathered and documented requirements, analyzed billing 
workflows, and collaborated with stakeholders to improve revenue tracking and minimize discrepancies. 
 
Digital Loan Management System (Finance) 
Analyzed and documented requirements for a digital loan processing platform that streamlined loan applications, credit 
evaluation, and approval workflows. Collaborated with stakeholders to define user journeys, reduce processing time, and 
improve decision accuracy through data-driven insights. 
 
 
Personalized Learning Analytics Platform (EdTech) 
Worked on a learning analytics system that tracked student performance and provided personalized course 
recommendations. Gathered requirements, created user stories, and supported the design of dashboards to help educators 
monitor progress and improve learning outcomes. 
 
FHIR Project (Healthcare) 
Led the design and development of a FHIR-based mobile application that enables seamless access and search of patient data 
from EMR systems, while ensuring alignment with business needs through detailed requirement gathering and SRS 
documentation. Additionally, built an appointment scheduling application using Agile methodology, allowing users to book 
online and offline consultations. Provided training to developers and clients on FHIR concepts and application usage, 
ensuring smooth development, adoption, and usability.  
 
Fraud Detection & Risk Monitoring System (Finance)  
Worked on a fraud detection platform to identify suspicious financial transactions using rule-based and data-driven 
approaches. Gathered and documented business requirements, defined risk indicators, and collaborated with stakeholders 
to design dashboards that improved fraud visibility and reduced financial losses.
